fields.summary_ko.0: Walmart (WMT) rose 3% intraday following Deutsche Bank's target price increase and upgrade from Neutral to Buy, with stronger value proposition in an inflationary environment and better price competitiveness versus peers.
fields.summary_ko.1: Walmart's Q2 US same-store sales growth of 2.6% was the lowest since Q4 2020, but it showed strong growth in grocery, e-commerce, and marketplace; high-margin businesses like advertising and membership are expected to support margins.
